title: Matsushita's Unsold Socket and the Order for Fan Insulator Plates
conflicts: Price advantage differs: 30% (Panasonic Episode 07, 2026) vs 30-50% (Panasonic chronicle, ITmedia) vs almost 50% (Gale); story gives Panasonic's two figures side by side. Founding team: three people per Panasonic/PHP/Entrepreneur vs wife plus three assistants per Gale; story names only the three. Kawakita Denki, the 1,000-plate order and 80-yen profit appear only in unconfirmed Japanese secondary accounts, so the story says only 'a large manufacturer' and 'repeat orders'. EBSCO's sequence (a profitable plug before the founding) differs from Panasonic's; story follows Panasonic. Starting capital figures vary; none used.
notes: Slate episode kept: the failed socket (1917) and the move to the attachment plug and two-way socket (1918). Sources are mostly Panasonic and PHP Institute material, backed by Entrepreneur (2018), Gale/encyclopedia.com, EBSCO and ITmedia (Japanese). Quote stance: affirms.
